name: Ian Midlane
bio: Ian Midlane is an actor best known for portraying Dr Al Haskey in the long-running BBC1 daytime soap Doctors from 2012 until the show's cancellation in 2024. In 2018,  he won the award for Best Comedy Performance at the British Soap Awards.  Midlane has also written three episodes of Doctors.

credits.title: Ebenezer
credits.overview: An elderly miser embarks on a supernatural journey after visits from the ghost of his former business partner and the Spirits of Christmas Past, Present, and Yet to Come force him to confront his past and fight for a second chance at happiness.

credits.title: Bridget Jones: Mad About the Boy
credits.overview: Bridget Jones navigates life as a widow and single mum with the help of her family, friends, and former lover, Daniel. Back to work and on the apps, she's pursued by a younger man and maybe – just maybe – her son's science teacher.

credits.title: Here Lies...
credits.overview: A widow visits a graveyard on the anniversary of her husband's death only to discover he has escaped from Hell.

credits.title: The Last Witness
credits.overview: An ambitious young journalist uncovers the horrific slaughter of 22,000 Polish officers during World War II, a secret kept hidden for far too many years.

credits.title: Swinging with the Finkels
credits.overview: A suburban couple decide to spice up their lives by swinging with another couple.

credits.title: Christine
credits.overview: Dangerous investigates the arson murder of a former lotto winner who is burned to death while drunk in a locked room.
